newsitem.title: CANADA: P&G Canada to raise Canada coffee prices.
newsitem.headline: P&G Canada to raise Canada coffee prices.

text.p: Procter & Gamble Co's Canadian division said on Thursday it will raise the price of Folgers coffee in Canada on February 1 to reflect gains in green bean prices.

"Our intention is to reflect North American green bean prices," said a spokeswoman for P & G's Canadian unit. "We last lowered the price on August 1, and that was to be in line with competitive pricing," she said.
The list price of a 300 gram (10.58 ounce) brick will rise to C$2.99 from C$2.79. The price of a one kilogram (35.27 ounce) can jumps to C$8.60 from C$7.94.
The price of an eight ounce instant coffee package increases to C$5.59 from C$4.99.

Futures prices on the Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange in New York jumped today to new contract highs as speculators bought heavily on a short-term supply squeeze. Benchmark March delivery prices rose 4.75 U.S. cents to close at 140.05 U.S. cents a pound, the highest close in five months.
